abilities.name: Anchor Bash
abilities.counterplay: Short melee reach; targeted spell block

abilities.name: Brace Wall
abilities.counterplay: Flank or displace; directional block does not stop control

abilities.name: Veil Step
abilities.counterplay: Geometric detectors, ground AoE; positive damage breaks concealment; active timed concealment only, does not become a learned passive

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.counterplay: Basic dispel or kite

abilities.name: Arc Bolt
abilities.counterplay: Spell block, resistance; projectile cannot track an unseen unit

abilities.name: Counterpulse
abilities.counterplay: Bait interrupt, spell block

abilities.name: Farwatch Ward
abilities.counterplay: Destroy or counterward; no wall sight

abilities.name: Wire Snare
abilities.counterplay: Detect and attack trap; basic dispel

abilities.name: Ledger Mark
abilities.counterplay: Basic dispel; tracks only observable cells, never live hidden target coordinates

abilities.name: Surety Shell
abilities.counterplay: Small hits or wait; no control immunity

abilities.name: False Trail
abilities.counterplay: Detector shows illusion cue, any hit destroys; cannot claim, trade, scout or block claims

abilities.name: Smoke Veil
abilities.counterplay: Ground AoE, enter cloud, destroy sightline advantage; smoke blocks detectors across its boundary

abilities.name: Purge Touch
abilities.counterplay: Silence/stun blocks self cast; mute does not

abilities.name: Seer’s Flare
abilities.counterplay: Leave sensor geometry or obscure line; never identity

abilities.name: Ember Line
abilities.counterplay: Walk around, resistance; each target receives at most listed total damage

abilities.name: Grapple

effects.target_rule: contender or small creature; not boss/tower

abilities.counterplay: Root/grounding prevents self movement; valid geometry, spell block on hostile pull

abilities.name: Null Seal
abilities.counterplay: Use spells or basic dispel; spell block

abilities.name: Grounding Field
abilities.counterplay: Destroy 90 HP emitter or walk out; does not prevent push/pull

abilities.name: Force Wave
abilities.counterplay: Walk out of cone, Anchor Greaves; ordinary spell block/dome do not block cone

abilities.name: Guard Swap

effects.marker_placement: first cast plants marker; second cast executes and starts full cooldown

abilities.counterplay: Destroy marker, root/grounding blocks swap; both endpoints walkable

abilities.name: Slipstream
abilities.counterplay: Root, grounding, walls

abilities.name: Remedy Bind
abilities.counterplay: Stunned users cannot self cast; preguard is short, bait or separate

abilities.name: Break Sigil
abilities.counterplay: Strong dispel, active defenses; ordinary stat bonuses remain

abilities.name: Arcane Prison
abilities.counterplay: Destroy anchor, blink if not rooted, never spawn wall intersecting body

abilities.name: Temporal Lock
abilities.counterplay: Leave telegraph, pre-control guard; targeted spell block does not block AoE

abilities.name: Sovereign Ward
abilities.counterplay: Enter on foot, melee, cone push, explicit instant interrupt; emitter takes damage

abilities.name: Grand Exchange
abilities.counterplay: Either target spell block stops entire swap; block geometry, interrupt windup

abilities.name: Gate Weave
abilities.counterplay: Destroy endpoint, guard exit; visible to others in sight, traversal permitted to all; no frozen invulnerability

abilities.name: Frostline
abilities.counterplay: Dodge line, preempt guard, leave river; frozen field itself never stuns

abilities.name: Firebolt
abilities.counterplay: Spell block, projectile dome, Water removes Burning

abilities.name: Water Jet
abilities.counterplay: Dodge line; Wet is setup rather than hard control

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.counterplay: Anchor stops push; Gust clears finite smoke/steam but does not reveal through walls

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.counterplay: Basic dispel, fire clears temporary growth; field is slow only

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.counterplay: Spell block on each packet; split up; jumps cannot acquire unseen targets

abilities.name: Ice Nova
abilities.counterplay: Leave visible windup radius; Wet reaction has shared target lock

abilities.name: Rain Call
abilities.counterplay: Field is visible; spreads Wet to everyone; Water extinguishes normal flames

abilities.name: Flameburst
abilities.counterplay: Avoid telegraph; melting ice creates steam for both sides

abilities.name: Static Lance
abilities.counterplay: Avoid conductive patches; lightning never applies stun in v08

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.counterplay: Basic dispel; no knock-up or altered vertical navigation

abilities.name: Vine Lash
abilities.counterplay: Spell block, basic dispel; roots do not interrupt an existing Heart claim

abilities.name: Cleanse Rain
abilities.counterplay: Aid consent required; no stun cleanse; neutralizes own Wet combo setup

abilities.name: Thawing Touch
abilities.counterplay: Only melts surface ice; creates symmetric steam, never silently dispels unit stun

abilities.name: Shatter Burst
abilities.counterplay: Requires Frozen cells, consumes ice; one hit/unit/cast, no Wet stun

abilities.name: Conductive Field
abilities.counterplay: Dry land gives no field; 18 raw magical damage/s; no stun

abilities.name: Thermal Veil
abilities.counterplay: Requires Wet/Frozen/river cells; symmetric vision occlusion; Gust clears

abilities.name: Deploy Conduit
abilities.counterplay: Attack emitter; requires aid consent for others; no field-reaction automation

abilities.name: Sabotage
abilities.counterplay: Attack/intercept caster; applies to traps/wards/conduits/anchors, not buildings or Heart

abilities.name: Rescue Line
abilities.counterplay: Recipient must opt in; root permits forced pull, Anchor prevents; Heart claim cancels on movement

abilities.name: Rally Guard
abilities.counterplay: Basic positive dispel; one pulse, not a learned passive; no control immunity

abilities.name: Disarming Cut
abilities.counterplay: Step away, spell block, basic cleanse; skills remain usable

abilities.name: Power Strike
abilities.counterplay: Dodge long windup; barrier bonus only affects absorbed portion, no generic Break

abilities.name: Scouting Pulse
abilities.counterplay: No detection through smoke/walls; no private build information
